findings.message: The text "Buscar" has at most 2.85:1 contrast with what is behind it (#999999 on #ffffff), measured from pixels because axe-core could not decide (a pseudo-element). WCAG 1.4.3 asks for 4.5:1.

findings.message: The placeholder "Do que você precisa hoje?" has a contrast of 2.85:1 with the field (#999999 on #ffffff). Placeholder text is text, and WCAG 1.4.3 asks for 4.5:1.

findings.message: This element ("Serviços para você!") takes keyboard focus and listens to click, so it works as a control, but the browser exposes it as heading, with no control role: a screen reader does not announce it as a button or a link (F59). Use the native element (button, a) or give it the role of the control it is.
findings.subject: heading click
